title: DCP v6 configuration
description: Request-scoped compression of old successful tool outputs. The host retains ownership of session storage and native compaction.

autoUpdate.description: Notify about a newer version; never installs it.

protectRecentSteps.description: Minimum number of recent complete tool execution steps retained verbatim, including within one user turn.

protectRecentTokens.description: Extend recent step protection until this estimated token count and the minimum step count are both retained.

targetRatio.description: Fraction of the conservative current-model input budget available for message history; leaves room for system and tool definitions.

minimumSavingsTokens.description: Minimum estimated saving required to fold one eligible successful tool output.

protectedTools.description: Additional tool names whose outputs must remain intact. Built-in protections cannot be disabled.

enabled.description: Expose dcp_prune, which requests one fold on the next ordinary model request. Only available when DTC is enabled.
